description: List HTAG public REST endpoints. Optional `tag` (e.g. 'Markets', 'Property', 'Spatial') and `query` (substring against path / summary) filters. Returns path, method, operationId, tags, and summary for each match.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive substring matched against the path, summary and operationId (e.g. 'sold', 'geocode').
query.title: Query

tag.description: Optional OpenAPI tag to filter by, case-insensitive exact match (e.g. 'Property', 'Address Geocode', 'Markets').
tag.title: Tag

name: list_api_endpoints
